title: Scaffolder for Optimizely settings
description: Per-solution settings for the Scaffolder for Optimizely Visual Studio extension. Every value is optional; anything left out is detected from the project.

templateSource.description: Where file content comes from. 'dotnet-new' uses Optimizely's EPiServer.Templates where it has a matching template and falls back to the built-in templates; 'embedded' always uses the built-in templates. Per-solution overrides in .optimizely/templates/ win either way.

layout.description: 'conventional' puts models, controllers, components, view models and views in their own folders. 'feature' keeps everything next to the item. Leave out to detect from where existing views live.

fileScopedNamespaces.description: Use file-scoped namespaces. Leave out to match existing code.

folders.description: Folders (relative to the project) used by the conventional layout, and when scaffolding from the project node.

baseClasses.description: Default base classes as full type names, e.g. 'MySite.Models.Pages.SitePageData'. Leave out to pick from abstract base classes found in the project.

contentTypeGroup.description: Default content type group expression, e.g. 'Globals.GroupNames.Content'.

companions.description: Default state of the companion-file checkboxes.
